note: First nuclear test years: widely documented dates (USA 1945, USSR/Russia 1949, UK 1952, France 1960, China 1964, India 1974, Pakistan 1998, North Korea 2006). Israel has never confirmed an arsenal and is shown separately. Warhead inventories: Federation of American Scientists, Status of World Nuclear Forces 2025 (estimates, total inventory incl. retired warheads awaiting dismantlement; sum 12,241, matching SIPRI's January 2025 estimate). Peak of about 70,300 warheads in 1986: FAS. South Africa dismantled its six devices by 1991; Ukraine, Belarus and Kazakhstan transferred Soviet-era weapons to Russia by 1996. Nuclear sharing: US weapons reported in Belgium, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands and Turkey under NATO arrangements; Russia announced the deployment of weapons in Belarus in 2023.
